_comment: EQRMSS class starter kits — granted by the character creation wizard finalizer. One kit per class (user-locked 2026-09-29). Money is a house rule (not historical): gp is fixed, cp is rolled. raceOverrides apply after the class kit: each race has a starter set (names only - stats come from the class kit), { raceKey: { Slot: 'Set piece name', Primary: '<Set name>' } }; the Primary entry is the set name and kit weapons are granted as '<Set name> <weapon noun>'. A '<raceKey>:<classKey>' entry scopes renames to one class. Race keys are the race id lowercased with any 'eqrmss-' prefix stripped.
